$note: Single source of truth. Regenerate by running extract-tokens.js whenever lib/thinkpattern.jsx or lib/data.js changes. Never hand-edit this file.

color.$note: All hues tuned for kraft-paper light surface only. Light mode is LOCKED in v1 — force light at the platform level (iOS: UIUserInterfaceStyle=Light, Android: forceDarkAllowed=false, RN/Expo: userInterfaceStyle:'light').

paper.usage: Primary background — kraft ground. Use on every screen.

paper2.usage: Raised surface — cards, sheets, modals atop paper.

ink.usage: Primary text — bistre. Headlines, body copy, labels.

muted.usage: Metadata — timestamps, source labels, captions. AA on paper (5.21:1).

faint.usage: Dividers and separators ONLY. Never use for text.

rule.usage: Masthead / full-width section rule — 1px hr under wordmark and section heads. Slightly stronger than faint; never for text or content dividers.

link.usage: Tappable text affordances on paper. AA (5.16:1).

linkPressed.usage: Press / active state for link. AAA (7.40:1).

accent.usage: The 'now' semantic — marks live nodes, active tabs, one hero beat per screen. NEVER decorative. NEVER use as a general accent.

accentSoft.usage: Soft ochre — background tints behind accent elements only.

slate.usage: Data-viz and brand mark only. NEVER a text accent or UI chrome color.

relation.$note: Actor relationship semantics. Each maps to a fixed meaning — do not repurpose for general UI color.

neutral.meaning: No significant alignment — same hue as muted by design

spacing.$note: 4-point grid. Every gap, padding, and margin is a rung. s{N} = N × 4px. 'hair' is the one sub-grid step — optical use only, never structural layout. Anything above s12 is bespoke (use a raw value with a comment, not a new rung).

typography.$note: Three families, three roles. Weight, leading, and family are compositional — the scale gives size only.

display.usage: Headlines, pull quotes, hero text. Display role only — not body or UI.

body.usage: All body copy, UI labels, navigation. The workhorse.

mono.usage: Tabular numerals, timestamps, counts, source labels. Monospace only — never prose.

scale.$note: Ten named roles, ascending. Each is a hierarchy level — components reach for a role name, never a raw px. Map each rung to one platform text style (e.g. TS.base → iOS .subheadline / Dynamic Type).

fine.usage: Metadata, fine print, source labels, blurbs

detail.usage: Secondary body, dense list copy, role lines

base.usage: Reading size — story and actor body text (the workhorse)

lead.usage: Lead paragraphs, list item titles, emphasised body

sub.usage: Subheads, lens header, card titles, wordmark

motion.$note: Durations in ms. Three named curves. Reduced-motion: collapse every transition to 120ms opacity fade, no transform. accent is never animated decoratively — motion signals spatial relationship only.

push.usage: Push navigation — leaf turn, depth forward

reduced.usage: Fallback for prefers-reduced-motion — opacity only, no transform

chrome.$note: Chrome is transparent and defers to the OS. Reserve space against safe-area insets — never overlap them. These values are the design-frame mock values; real hardware resolves env() to device-reported insets.

notifications.$note: ThinkPattern is defined against the notifications-engine model. Push is rationed, not maximised. App-icon badge removed (OS support); unread dot lives on the tab bar only.

story.trigger: Story cluster crosses significance threshold or materially updates
